summary.text: Ashley Gantt represents District 109 in the Florida House of Representatives. According to the House, Gantt was elected in 2022 and reelected subsequently.

paragraphs.text: The House lists Gantt's residence as Miami and an occupation of attorney and law firm owner. It also lists past experience as a Broward County public defender and as a public school teacher.
Gantt holds a bachelor's degree in English from the University of Florida and a J.D. from Nova Southeastern University's Shepard Broad College of Law.
